notes: Version 2.3 aligns the note with Q6a 2.6, which corrects two statements that the note consumed. A gauge charge, a functional constant on the projection fibres, factors through the projection and is therefore a function of the observable state; the note no longer describes it as an invariant that the projection does not resolve, and its identification with a conserved physical charge is recorded as open. Q6a's two continuum hypotheses, a smooth fibre bundle and a differentiable base, are needed but do not determine a connection; the note now records the connection as supplied together with the structure group and its representation, read as the generator of parallel transport on those data, with the field strength measuring the path dependence of transport. No other statement of the note is changed.
